title: Copewell: A Multi-Agent Swarm Architecture for Equitable Mental Wellness Support

bias_targets.methodology: Architectural mapping and qualitative evaluation against the FAITA-MH framework's Equity and Inclusivity dimension, assessing the system's 20-language support and use of a cross-culturally valid dimensional emotion model (empirical measurement is explicitly noted as pending).

Architectural evaluation using the FAITA-MH framework to assess the system's accessibility for vulnerable and low-resource populations, specifically focusing on its mobile-first and low-bandwidth design commitments.

Theoretical and architectural evaluation of a multi-source assessment framework (combining self-reported, physiological, and contextual data) designed to mitigate systematic measurement bias arising from single-modality inputs.
